A CONTEXTUAL CLUE

The words around the redaction matter.

An independent tester identifies a possible reconstruction path. The officer can sever that context, rerun checks and record a rationale.

HUMAN JUDGMENT, BUILT INTO THE WORKFLOW

Assistance is useful.
Accountability is essential.

✓

Every suggestion gets a decision.

Approve withholding, disclose with a rationale, or change the legal category.

✓

Every finding gets a response.

Document mitigation or a reasoned assessment of the remaining risk.

✓

Changed output gets fresh checks.

Release validates the hash of the exact candidate text reviewed.

✓

The requester receives only the release.

Originals stay officer-only. Exported PDFs contain replaced text, not overlays.
